summary: EdgeOne Makers offers an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway. New accounts receive 500K free tokens as a limited-time offer, shared across all projects under the same account, with no credit card or payment method required for the free tier. Built-in models such as @makers/deepseek-v4-flash (DeepSeek, MiniMax, and Hunyuan) can be called without a provider key; bring-your-own-key vendors are billed only on the vendor's own platform, and Makers adds no fees.
claim_steps: Sign up at the Makers console and create your gateway API key.
Set the base URL to the Makers gateway endpoint in any OpenAI-compatible SDK.
Send requests with your chosen built-in model parameter, e.g. @makers/deepseek-v4-flash.
